name: ragbase
description: For Claude Code (developers). RAGbase plugins. RAGbase Shield: local pseudonymisation so Claude works on client files with codes for the names Shield detects or you register. In the Claude app, use the Claude plugin instead: add ragbase/ragbase-shield-mac (Mac) or ragbase/ragbase-shield-windows (Windows) as a marketplace.

plugins.name: ragbase-shield
plugins.description: For Claude Code (developers). Local pseudonymisation for client files: masked document reading through MCP tools, hooks that block real names in prompts and direct reads of dossier folders, and a skill for the safe workflow. In the Claude app, use the Claude plugin instead: add ragbase/ragbase-shield-mac (Mac) or ragbase/ragbase-shield-windows (Windows) as a marketplace.
